title: Implement MARBLE PriceTrackerCollaborator and pass the sealed suite
goal: Implement the MARBLE coding benchmark task PriceTrackerCollaborator (task_id=4 in multiagentbench/coding/coding_main.jsonl at the pinned commit) as workspace/gc-328/solution.py per assets/gc-328/SPEC.md: multi-retailer price histories, latest-price resolution by timestamp, threshold alerts with once-per-event delivery, group alert sharing, and buy-timing insights. The alert deduplication and share-copy semantics are easy to get subtly wrong, so plan the event flow first, implement in increments, and rerun the sealed suite after each increment while tracking red tests by name. Finish with a green re-verification inside the pinned container.

spec.command: python -m pip install -q pytest==8.3.3 && python -m pytest assets/gc-328/test_accept.py -q --tb=no -p no:cacheprovider

process_expectations: A plan artifact exists before coding that specifies the notification events and the alert-copy rule for group sharing
The sealed suite was executed after each increment with logs retained, including at least one red run before the final green
Red tests are tracked by pytest node id across iterations, not by count
Verification runs and their costs/outcomes are logged honestly, including failures
The sealed suite file is never edited; all recovery happens in workspace/gc-328/solution.py
